field.label: Enable Chat
field.comment: Master on/off switch for the Conferbot widget on the storefront.

field.label: Chatbot ID
field.comment: Paste your bot ID (24-character code). In the Conferbot dashboard open your bot, click Share, then Embed into your website: the ID is inside ConferbotWidget("...") in the code and in the address bar (.../chatbot/ID/embed). You can also paste the full embed snippet or a dashboard URL and the ID is extracted for you. No account yet? Paste 691c970890527a0468f9b2c9 to try our demo bot - it works right away, no signup needed.

field.label: How the Chat Appears
field.comment: Floating chat bubble (default) or popup window.

field.label: Identity Verification Secret (optional)
field.comment: From Conferbot workspace settings > Security > Identity verification. Each logged-in customer is then signed on your server, so Conferbot can trust their name and email. Stored encrypted; never sent to the browser.

field.label: Widget Script URL
field.comment: Leave as is for the Conferbot CDN. Useful for staging/self-hosted widget builds.
